title: Northern Ireland's most caps since 2000
brief: Name the ten players with the most caps for Northern Ireland in full internationals since 1 January 2000, to the end of the 2026 World Cup. Only caps from 2000 on count.
period: Full internationals from 1 January 2000 to 19 July 2026

notes.Craig Cathcart: Craig Cathcart is joint 11th with 73, just outside.
notes.Niall McGinn: Niall McGinn is joint 11th with 73, just outside.
notes.Aaron Hughes: Aaron Hughes won 112 caps; 10 came in 1998 and 1999.
notes.Maik Taylor: Maik Taylor won 88 caps; 8 came in 1999.
notes.Keith Gillespie: Keith Gillespie won 86 caps, 57 of them from 2000.
notes.Pat Jennings: Pat Jennings's caps all came before 2000.

sources: https://www.transfermarkt.com/ceapi/performance-game/<player id> (every match a player played, filtered to the national team and the date window)
checks: Counted match by match from Transfermarkt's per-game data, 1 January 2000 to 19 July 2026. Totals for players who began after 2000 checked against RSSSF (to 7 June 2026) and Wikipedia: they agree, except Jonny Evans (107 there, 108 on Transfermarkt; 107 used). Aaron Hughes 102 from 2000 matches the by-year table in his Wikipedia article. Maik Taylor (first cap March 1999) is 80 on Transfermarkt; Northern Ireland played 8 matches in 1999, so he has at least 80 and at most 88 from 2000, in the ten either way.
